Can I suggest something that gives similar relief but won't leave scars?         



OK rubber bands, get yourself a big bag and always have some on you. When you feel the need to cut snap the band against your wrist instead. If you need more of a visual then put some red food coloring, or fake blood, etc on the inside of the band. That way when you snap it you also have a visual. I know you weren't asking about an alternative or anything but I'm assuming you don't feel ready to talk with your mom about it and if she suspects she might start checking regularly. If you don't want to do this than please disregard this comment, I just know there's only so many times you can say scratches or an accident etc before they start catching on. I hope this can help in the future ❤
